scenario.goal_zh: 核实新手参与方式及教练安排后预约体验

context_zh: 成年初学者咨询飞行学校的入门体验，讨论教学安排而非飞行操作。
author: author-phase03-c

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I've always wanted to try flying, but I've never been in a small plane.

sentences.speaker: Instructor Ellis
sentences.text: Our introductory lesson is for beginners. An instructor stays with you throughout.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I get nervous easily. Would I have to take the controls straight away?

sentences.speaker: Instructor Ellis
sentences.text: No. We start with a briefing, and you can ask questions before deciding how much you want to try.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: A friend said your instructor, Jo, was excellent with nervous students. Could I book with her?

sentences.speaker: Instructor Ellis
sentences.text: She's available on Sunday morning. Shall I send you the lesson details and booking conditions?

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Yes, please. I'll read those before I choose a time.
